general.title: General information
general.name: Tariff name
general.carrierLocked: Cannot be changed on a saved tariff
general.validToHelp: Leave empty for no end date
general.scopeHelp: Fills in the divisor and fuel type: domestic 3000 and fixed fuel, international 5000 and variable fuel.
general.activeSub: Invoices can be compared against this tariff
general.defaultSub: The preferred tariff for this carrier's invoices

weight.title: Billable weight
weight.desc: The larger of actual and volumetric weight (L × W × H ÷ divisor) is billed.

steps.title: Weight steps
steps.desc: Chargeable weight is rounded up to the step of the band it falls in. E.g. up to 20 kg step 0.5: 9.45 → 9.5 kg; above, step 1: 21.2 → 22 kg.

pricing.title: Discount and fuel
pricing.desc: The discount is applied first, then fuel is added to the remainder.
pricing.fuelModeHelp: Variable: no difference is raised when the carrier changes its fuel rate; a rate note shows at the top of the invoice. Fixed: a fuel rate higher than the tariff counts as a price difference.

zones.title: Zone mapping
zones.desc: The zone column for each destination country; "*" means all other countries.
zones.empty: No mapping. Invoice lines will show "No tariff" because no zone can be found.

surcharges.title: Surcharges
surcharges.desc: A surcharge code not listed here is flagged as a difference on the invoice.
surcharges.name: Name

adjustments.title: Country exceptions
adjustments.desc: Country-specific difference: -15 means the freight is 15% cheaper.
adjustments.empty: No country exceptions; all countries are calculated from the rate table.
adjustments.descView: Country-specific difference: -15 means the freight is 15% cheaper.

notice.created: Tariff created. Check the prices, zones and surcharges below, then save your changes with Save.
notice.createdFromFile: Tariff created from “{{file}}”. Check the prices, zones and surcharges below, then save your changes with Save.
notice.applied: The prices in the file were applied.
notice.affectedCreated_one: {{formatted}} invoice from this carrier was calculated before this tariff existed. Move it to this tariff?
notice.affectedCreated_other: {{formatted}} invoices from this carrier were calculated before this tariff existed. Move them to this tariff?
notice.affectedOld_one: {{formatted}} invoice stays on the tariff as it was on the day it was calculated. Move it to the new tariff?
notice.affectedOld_other: {{formatted}} invoices stay on the tariff as it was on the day they were calculated. Move them to the new tariff?
notice.otherInvoices_one: {{formatted}} invoice from this carrier is compared with another tariff, so this tariff does not change it. To use this tariff, edit the invoice and select it.
notice.otherInvoices_other: {{formatted}} invoices from this carrier are compared with another tariff, so this tariff does not change them. To use this tariff, edit the invoice and select it.
notice.recomparedSkipped: {{n}} invoices were skipped (in dispute or changed meanwhile).

versions.title: Version history
versions.desc: The previous state is kept on every save and import.

versions.descView: The previous state is kept on every save and import.

restore.title: Restore this version?

restore.info: The tariff's current state is also saved to the version history, so you can go back to it at any time.
restore.dirtyWarn: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

leave.label: Tariff
leave.title: Changes not saved
leave.body: If you leave this page, the changes you made to the tariff will be lost.

quote.title: Calculate a price
quote.saveFirst: Save the tariff first to calculate a price.

grid.title: Rate table
grid.desc: Row is the weight limit, column is the zone. You can paste from Excel.
grid.perKgAria: Per-kg pricing for the {{weight}} kg row
grid.perKgOn: Per-kg pricing: click to turn off
grid.perKgOff: Turn on if the prices in this band are per kg
grid.overflowHint: For weights above the table: the last row's price plus this amount for each extra step
grid.help: Above table, per step: for a shipment heavier than the largest weight in the table, the amount added to the last row's price for each extra step. /kg: turn on if the band's price is per kg (e.g. 71–99 kg: 7.27 {{sym}}/kg × billable kg). Enter moves to the cell below.

ambiguous.title: These numbers can be read two ways
ambiguous.body: In the table you copied, "{{example}}" could be {{asTr}} or {{asEn}}. Nothing in the table settles it, and we do not guess so that prices are not misread.
ambiguous.hint: Your choice applies to every number in the table.

grid.descView: Each row is an upper weight limit, each column a zone.

stale.title: This tariff changed while you were viewing it.
stale.body: Someone else or another tab saved it. Loading the latest version discards your unsaved changes. If you save anyway, the other change stays in the version history.

pack.desc: Rates for shipments in the carrier's pak or envelope. If empty, these shipments are not checked.
pack.empty: No pak or envelope rates. Add a row with the button above.
pack.discountHelp: If empty, the tariff discount applies.
